editorial:
Ever wonder what would happen if Superman met a group of heroes who actually enjoyed killing bad guys? That is exactly where this story kicks off. You get to see the Man of Steel struggle as a new team called The Elite arrives on the scene. These guys make Superman look old-fashioned because they use brutal force to solve every problem. It creates a really cool tension where you start questioning if being a nice guy is actually a weakness in a world full of monsters. The vibe is a mix of high-stakes action and a deep look at what it really means to be a hero.

You will probably love the fight scenes and the way the voice acting brings out the frustration in Superman's voice. The pacing moves fast, though some parts of the plot feel a bit rushed. endingExplained: At the end, Superman lets the leader of The Elite think he has finally won. He pretends to lose his morals and kills a villain to prove a point. However, he uses a clever trick to make it look like a kill without actually murdering anyone. This exposes the Elite as bullies rather than heroes. They realize Superman is stronger because he has a code, and the team is eventually defeated and locked up.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves comic books and stories about morality.
